Jurisdictions and research coverage

The listed jurisdictions define the geographic scope of the observatory. A listed jurisdiction is not a claim that an instrument exists, applies, or has been researched.

Research status is derived from recorded policy records, candidate source leads and queued tasks. A jurisdiction with no record has not been researched here; that is not evidence that no law exists.
